articles.title: Jasmine plant care: 7 easy tips to grow healthy plants and enjoy more fragrant flowers at home
articles.description: There's a particular kind of joy that comes from stepping onto your balcony in the evening and catching that first hit of jasmine fragrance drifting through the air, the kind of smell that instantly makes a home feel a little calmer. But plenty of people who grow jasmine end up with a plant that's more leaves than flowers, or worse, one that barely blooms at all despite genuinely trying to care for it. The good news is that jasmine isn't actually a fussy plant once you understand what it wants, and a few small adjustments can be the difference between a plant that just survives and one that fills your whole home with fragrance every evening.

articles.title: Young Hero Koushik Mekala On A Roll With Multiple Projects
articles.description: Young and promising hero Koushik Mekala, who has impressed audiences with projects like Priyuraalu and the ZEE5 series SIT, is steadily making his presence felt with a diverse lineup of content. Known for choosing interesting roles and exploring different genres, the talented actor is currently busy juggling films, web series and commercial assignments. Koushik recently played the lead in the web series Part-Timers, which has been receiving a positive response and is progressing successfully. He has also featured in advertisements alongside popular stars like Nagarjuna and Jr NTR, further expanding his visibility across different platforms. The actor now has several interesting projects in the pipeline. Viral Video, in which Koushik plays a key role, is gearing up for release. Besides this, around three more films featuring him are currently in production, while a few other projects are in various stages of discussion. Koushik has also collaborated with director Varun Reddy, known for Psych Siddhartha, on an upcoming project that is currently in the production phase. Another film in which he plays the lead, directed by GV Ramaraju, is also ready for release. The film, produced under the Fine Frame Films banner, is currently in the post-production stage. With multiple films and web projects lined up, Koushik Mekala is steadily expanding his repertoire and exploring a wide range of characters. More details about his upcoming projects are expected to be announced soon, making his next phase of work an interesting one to watch out for.
